verdict.rationale: ESD holds claimant and employer data through EAMS and SecureAccess Washington, so asking whether it uses that data for AI training is a fair question. The evidence pack contains nothing on AI training, data-use policy, or any opt-out control. The open pages cover only unemployment tax, reporting and benefits guidance, and the authenticated portal could not be inspected.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
